title: Kissed Crunchy Egyptian Sweet Potatoes Fritters
description: A sweet, crunchy Egyptian dish perfect for post-workout snacking, made with cinnamon and deep-fried to perfection. This recipe is sugar-free friendly.
instructions: Grate the baked sweet potatoes using a box grater.
In a large bowl, combine the grated sweet potatoes, flour, and baking powder.
Add a pinch of cinnamon and mix well.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, carefully place the patties into the pan and fry until golden brown.
Flip the fritters over and fry the other side until equally golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters warm, garnished with a sprinkle of cinnamon if desired.
